description: A competitor is mid-crisis over a representation issue. Audiences are primed and pattern-matching: copy that would normally pass is being read against the ongoing story. Fictional headlines attributed to invented outlets.

items.headline: Cosmetics brand loses two retail partners as backlash over casting decision enters second week
Leaked brief shows the campaign's diversity review was skipped under deadline
Rival labels' older campaigns resurface as users compile side-by-side comparisons
Agencies report surge in pre-launch representation audits across the category
Analysts say category-wide spillover is likely regardless of which brand erred

active_controversies: Competitor's casting decision is in its second week of sustained backlash
Users are actively compiling side-by-side comparisons of rival brands' past campaigns
Skipped internal diversity review has made process, not just output, part of the story
